timeline.evidenceText: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.
Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.
He found him in a desert land,
Then the Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself with us in the strongholds in the woods, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of the desert?
They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.
The Ziphites came to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert?”
Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert, by the way. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness,
but gave in to craving in the desert,
They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way.
Behold, I will do a new thing.
The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me,

definitions.full: H3452. yeshimon יְשִׁימוֺן noun masculine waste, wilderness ; — absolute יְשִׁימוֺן 1Sam 23:19 5 t.; יְשִׁימֹן Num 21:20 3 t.; יְשִׁמוֺן Isa 43:19 ; יְשִׁמֹן Deut 32:10 ; construct יְשִׁימוֺן Psa 107:4 ; — waste, wilderness: a. with article, almost proper name Num 21:20 (commanded by Pisgah), 23:28 (by Pe`or; both J E), frequented by David as an outlaw 1Sam 23:19 , 24 ; 26:1 , 3 . Probably some part of the wilderness of Judah, bordering on Dead Sea (Conder Tent work, ch. 15 ; Buhl Geogr. § 61 ); according to others, at least in Numbers (see Di), part of the `Arábah, northeast of the Dead Sea (in which was הַיְשִׁימֹת בֵּית Num 33:49 and elsewhere) b. without article, a waste or wilderness (only in poetry), of scene of Israel's wanderings (after the Exodus), יְשׁ יְלֵל ׳בְּתֹהוּ Deut 32:10 (|| מִדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ ), Psa 68:8 ; 78:40 ; 106:14 ; with reference to returning exiles Isa 43:19-20 , ׳י דֶּרֶךְ Psa 107:4 waste of a way ( = desert way).
